section_title: Money Laundering Risks in Financial Services > Shell and shelf companies risks

propositions.proposition: 壳公司、现成公司和幌公司在客户准入中视为高风险。
source_quotes: While there are legitimate uses for shell, shelf, and front companies, within the context of researching and accepting customers, they are considered high risk.

trigger_or_context: 客户准入（researching and accepting customers）
candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 壳公司、现成公司和幌公司被视为高风险

evidence_spans.quote: While there are legitimate uses for shell, shelf, and front companies, within the context of researching and accepting customers, they are considered high risk.

propositions.proposition: FATF发现壳公司和名义人被广泛用于洗钱，因此壳公司被认为代表更高洗钱风险。
source_quotes: When FATF reviewed the rules and practices that impair the effectiveness of financial crime prevention and detection systems, it found in particular that shell corporations and nominees are widely used mechanisms to launder the proceeds from crime. As a result, shell companies are considered to represent a higher risk of financial crime.

trigger_or_context: FATF审查妨碍金融犯罪预防和检测有效性的规则和实践
basis_or_condition: 壳公司和名义人被广泛用于洗钱
candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 壳公司被认为代表更高洗钱风险

evidence_spans.quote: When FATF reviewed the rules and practices that impair the effectiveness of financial crime prevention and detection systems, it found in particular that shell corporations and nominees are widely used mechanisms to launder the proceeds from crime. As a result, shell companies are considered to represent a higher risk of financial crime.

propositions.proposition: 丹麦银行总部对爱沙尼亚分行的反洗钱合规失败不知情，原因是缺乏充分的监督和监督。
source_quotes: An additional finding of the scandal revealed that Danske Bank’s head office was unaware of the AML compliance failings, including the lack of an MLRO appointment for over a year, as they did not have adequate oversight and supervision of the Estonian branch and of the transactions that were being processed.

trigger_or_context: 丹麦银行洗钱丑闻调查
basis_or_condition: 总部缺乏对爱沙尼亚分支机构的充分监督和监督
candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 总部对反洗钱合规失败不知情
outcomes_or_paths: 反洗钱合规失败，包括一年多未任命MLRO

evidence_spans.quote: An additional finding of the scandal revealed that Danske Bank’s head office was unaware of the AML compliance failings, including the lack of an MLRO appointment for over a year, as they did not have adequate oversight and supervision of the Estonian branch and of the transactions that were being processed.

propositions.proposition: 丹麦银行因洗钱丑闻认罪银行欺诈共谋并支付超过20亿美元罚款。
source_quotes: According to a press release by the US Department of Justice, Danske Bank faced significant regulatory scrutiny, leading to the resignation of several top executives. Danske Bank pleaded guilty to bank fraud conspiracy and paid substantial fines of more than US$2 billion.

trigger_or_context: 丹麦银行洗钱丑闻及监管审查
candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 丹麦银行认罪银行欺诈共谋

evidence_spans.quote: According to a press release by the US Department of Justice, Danske Bank faced significant regulatory scrutiny, leading to the resignation of several top executives. Danske Bank pleaded guilty to bank fraud conspiracy and paid substantial fines of more than US$2 billion.
